Name: Farm Building - Home Spa (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General[/size][/b]
Passing out at 2am every other day must be draining, so it's only fair for the farmer to have their own little relaxation center at home. 

The Home Spa is a 7x3 farm building that can be constructed by Robin for 20000g, 750 wood, 500 stone, 20 gold bars and 10 clay. The inside of the building is separated into two spaces.

[b]The entrance space includes:[/b]
- a mirror to change your appearance (like at the wizard's shrine)
- a sewing machine, available to use after Emily's sewing machine cutscene
- dye pots
- a computer where you can buy shirts, pants and mannequins
- a calendar
- a radio where you can change the music playing in the building

In the back room, there's a cozy pool area where you can replenish your energy. You will change in and out of your swimsuit when walking into or out of the room.

[size=4][b]Permissions[/b][/size]
If you want to make your own recolor/retexture, translation, add items to be processed, or make any other kind of change to this mod and post it, you are free to do so and use my assets, as long as your mod is an add-on (using my mod as a dependency) and doesn't just copy/replace this one. Please only use my assets for the things you are changing.

Enjoy!
